set.body:
Scope

Add a repository CI lane that enforces the public first-level computational boundary without depending on live external-language environments.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Pull requests and protected-branch pushes run hrfJVM/test, hrfJS/test, hrfLawsJVM/test, hrfLawsJS/test, designJVM/test, designJS/test, modelJVM/test, modelJS/test, fitJVM/test, and fitJS/test.
- [ ] CI validates docs/scenarios/manifest.json and runs the external fixture exporter in --check mode.
- [ ] The job uses the repository-declared Scala, sbt, Node, and JDK requirements and does not silently resolve through an adjacent developer checkout.
- [ ] Caching cannot turn a compile/test failure into a successful no-op; logs identify every invoked project/platform gate.
- [ ] PR CI does not install or execute live R/Python reference stacks; those belong to a separate regeneration lane.
- [ ] Workflow concurrency cancels superseded runs without masking the newest result.
- [ ] A documented local command bundle reproduces the CI lane.
- [ ] A deliberately stale fixture or failing JVM/JS scenario makes the workflow red.
- [ ] No release-readiness claim is made from configured jobs until a real run receipt exists.
set.title: P0.2: enforce focused first-level JVM/Scala.js and scenario gates in CI
